svg.text: Competitor’s latency ÷ Predibase’s. Above 1, Predibase was faster.
• 4× appears in just 2 cells: NER at P95, 15–20 QPS, vs. default vLLM (boxed).
• vs. Fireworks: 2.1× at most; Fireworks ties or wins on preference P50 at 1–5 QPS.
• Predibase is fastest in 43 of 45 test conditions, matching its “96%.”
“Up to 4×” is 2 cells out of 75; against Fireworks it’s about 2×.
Source: Rubrik / Predibase post (May 2025), labeled latencies; ratios are ours
